title: Release-process v1 credential declaration
description: Validates the value of one contribution to the credentials extension point of contract release-process version 1. Credential preflight checks that each declared secret or variable is present before any job that changes state outside the run.

name.description: The secret or variable name, as GitHub stores it.

kind.description: Where GitHub stores the value. Omitted means secret.

purpose.description: One line that tells an operator what the value is for. Preflight prints it when the value is absent.

environment.description: The GitHub environment that holds the value. Omitted means a repository or organization value.
